verdict.rationale: Appwrite's database docs list a dedicated VectorsDB product to "store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features." Its managed PostgreSQL option also documents installing pgvector, a second first-party path for the same story. The evidence is only one-line product descriptions, though. missing for 10: details on vector index types, distance metrics, dimensions and query/SDK APIs, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that similarity search works in practice.
